events.description:
Ookwemin St 7 m Southeast of Villiers St to 93 m Southeast of Villiers St — Toronto-TMC: The proposed scope of work includes the advancement of 5 boreholes to a maximum depth of fifteen (15) metres below grade (mbg)
within the roadway and public right-of-way along northwest portion of Ookwemin Street. All 5 boreholes will be completed as
monitoring wells using 50 mm diameter Schedule 40 PVC pipe with 3-metre screens and flushto-grade casings. The work will be conducted using hydrovac to daylight locations first, followed by hollow-stem auguring, and each borehole/monitoring well will be sampled for soil and groundwater. Traffic control measures, including signage, barriers, and personnel, will be implemented where required, and the boreholes may require daylighting to safely expose underground utilities prior to drilling.
